coverage: Whole company · manufacturing and trading of textile products
definition: Company profit after costs, the warehouse fire charge and tax.
location: Audited standalone statement for the financial year ended 31 March 2026, rows I, V–IX and the explanatory note on the Bhiwandi warehouse fire.
notes: The audited statement reports one textile operating segment. The exceptional loss from the warehouse fire was ₹1.37 crore. Profit after tax was ₹19.30 crore. The investor presentation separately shows consumer and business sales without matching profit figures.
insight: Both company sales and profit rose in the year. Compare them with the cash flow statement because buying more stock and waiting for sales payments can hold back cash.
